scope: Trade history with independently matched draft/keeper evidence, add/waiver receipts, and player-manager credited regular-season starts (2020–2026 archive).
methodology: Trade events trace archived asset appearances; a later trade does not itself prove continuously held ownership in between.
Draft picks and keeper flags come from historical draft records; a keeper-draft flag is evidence of keeper status for that season, not proof of an unbroken ownership chain.
Waiver and free-agent adds are identified by matching player name and transaction date. Stored team IDs are not automatically assigned to managers where tenure mappings are uncertain.
Credited starts/points come from player-to-manager season lineups. They are not causally attributed to a particular trade or keeper without transactional continuity.
Championships and multi-season value attribution cannot responsibly be assigned to individual trade branches without verified ownership links.
Receiving-side trade metrics are not player-specific measures.
